item.title: Why Are the Costs and Risks of Cybersecurity So Widely Distributed Across the Private Sector?
item.description: Starting from the debate over criminal liability for CISOs, this post traces Internet commercialization, information asymmetry, responsibilization, security externalities, CVD, NIS2, the CRA, and Korea's 2026 reforms to ask how cybersecurity responsibility has been distributed—and why it is now being rebalanced.

item.title: Does Hiring the World's Best Hackers Improve Security?
item.description: Bringing world-class hackers and a CTF research ecosystem into an organization can make it stronger, but real security improvement requires turning offensive capability into governance and structural change.
